claims.claim: Royce 1970 在单趟顺序图(Fig.2:系统需求→软件需求→分析→程序设计→编码→测试→运行)正下方第一句即称其实施方式有风险:他'相信这个概念',但所描述的实施'有风险且招致失败';问题在于测试是第一次实际经验(而非分析)时序/存储/IO 的时点,失败时需重大重设计,'可预期最多 100% 的进度和/或成本超支'。
claims.quote: I believe in this concept, but the implementation described above is risky and invites failure. ... In effect the development process has returned to the origin and one can expect up to a 100-percent overrun in schedule and/or costs.
claims.source_url: https://github.com/tpn/pdfs (文件 'Managing the Development of Large Software Systems - 1970 (waterfall).pdf', sha256 9f7db065…a78)
claims.source_title: Royce, W.W., 1970, Managing the Development of Large Software Systems, Proc. IEEE WESCON (TRW 重印本 pp.328-338)
claims.notes: 一手 PDF(扫描件)经 pdftotext 抽取并对照页面图像核对;与 tamnd/papers 的 olmOCR 转录同一 PDF(sha 一致)。 '100-percent overrun' 是作者经验判断,无数据。流行说法'Royce 反对瀑布'只对一半:他反对的是'不加五步修正的'实施,不是阶段化本身(见 H02)。

claims.claim: Royce 并未否定阶段化顺序:同页明言该方法'根本上是健全的',全文是在此'基本方法'上追加五项特征(程序设计先行、文档化设计、做两遍、规划与监控测试、让客户参与)以'消除大部分开发风险';总结称不加这五步的'更简单方法'在大型项目中'从未奏效'。
claims.quote: However, I believe the illustrated approach to be fundamentally sound. The remainder of this discussion presents five additional features that must be added to this basic approach to eliminate most of the development risks. ... In my experience, however, the simpler method has never worked on large software development efforts and the costs to recover far exceeded those required to finance the five-step process listed.
claims.source_url: https://github.com/tpn/pdfs (文件 'Managing the Development of Large Software Systems - 1970 (waterfall).pdf', sha256 9f7db065…a78)
claims.source_title: Royce, W.W., 1970, Managing the Development of Large Software Systems, Proc. IEEE WESCON (TRW 重印本 pp.328-338)
claims.notes: 一手 PDF(扫描件)经 pdftotext 抽取并对照页面图像核对;与 tamnd/papers 的 olmOCR 转录同一 PDF(sha 一致)。 关键口径:'simpler method' 指不加五步的 Fig.2 流程,不是'瀑布 vs 迭代'。Royce 的修正方向是'更多前置设计和文档 + 一次试点',而非轻文档迭代——这是与 SDD 同构的地方。

claims.claim: Royce 承认设计迭代会越过相邻阶段:Fig.3 是'理想'(迭代只发生在相邻步骤),Fig.4 图注直言对所示流程'设计迭代从不局限于相邻步骤'。
claims.quote: Figure4. Unfortunately, for the process illustrated, the design iterations are never confined to the successive steps.
claims.source_url: https://github.com/tpn/pdfs (文件 'Managing the Development of Large Software Systems - 1970 (waterfall).pdf', sha256 9f7db065…a78)

claims.claim: Royce 是重文档/规约先行的倡导者:'文档化设计'一节称需要'相当多'文档,'管理软件开发的第一条规则是无情地强制执行文档要求';文档严重不足时他的建议是'撤换项目管理层,停止一切与文档无关的活动';并宣称在编码开始前'文档、规约、设计'三者是同一件事。
claims.quote: The first rule of managing software development is ruthless enforcement of documentation requirements. ... Replace project management. Stop all activities not related to documentation. ... During the early phase of software development the documentation is the specification and is the design. Until coding begins these three nouns (documentation, specification, design) denote a single thing. If the documentation is bad the design is bad.
claims.source_url: https://github.com/tpn/pdfs (文件 'Managing the Development of Large Software Systems - 1970 (waterfall).pdf', sha256 9f7db065…a78)
claims.source_title: Royce, W.W., 1970, Managing the Development of Large Software Systems, Proc. IEEE WESCON (TRW 重印本 pp.328-338)

claims.claim: Royce 给出规模对比:采购 500 万美元硬件约需 30 页规约,采购 500 万美元软件约需 '1?00' 页规约方可达到同等控制。扫描件该数字残损:页面图像中第二位字符缺损,olmOCR 转录读作 1000,常见二手转述作 1500。
claims.quote: In order to procure a 5 million dollar hardware device, I would expect that a 30 page specification would provide adequate detail to control the procurement. In order to procure 5 million dollars of software I would estimate a 1[?]00 page specification is about right in order to achieve comparable control.
claims.source_url: https://github.com/tpn/pdfs (文件 'Managing the Development of Large Software Systems - 1970 (waterfall).pdf', sha256 9f7db065…a78)
claims.source_title: Royce, W.W., 1970, Managing the Development of Large Software Systems, Proc. IEEE WESCON (TRW 重印本 pp.328-338)
claims.notes: 已在 400dpi 页面图像上核对:字符形似 '1500' 但第二位残损,不可确定 1000/1500。成文时写'上千页'或注明数字残损,不得单点引用 1500。纯经验估计,无数据。

claims.claim: Royce 第 3 步'做两遍':若产品是首创,应安排交付给客户的版本实为关键设计/运行领域的'第二版';例:30 个月项目可安排 10 个月试点模型,12 个月项目试点压缩到约 3 个月;第 5 步要求客户在需求定义后的三个节点正式介入。
claims.quote: If the computer program in question is being developed for the first time, arrange matters so that the version finally delivered to the customer for operational deployment is actually the second version insofar as critical design/operations areas are concerned. ... If the effort runs 30 months then this early development of a pilot model might be scheduled for 10 months.
claims.source_url: https://github.com/tpn/pdfs (文件 'Managing the Development of Large Software Systems - 1970 (waterfall).pdf', sha256 9f7db065…a78)
claims.source_title: Royce, W.W., 1970, Managing the Development of Large Software Systems, Proc. IEEE WESCON (TRW 重印本 pp.328-338)

claims.claim: Royce 认为分析与编码阶段'通常管理起来相对容易',对需求、设计、测试影响很小;困难在于两头(需求/设计与测试)。即 1970 年的大型系统语境中编码已被视为相对廉价的环节。
claims.quote: One cannot, of course, produce software without these steps, but generally these phases are managed with relative ease and have little impact on requirements, design, and testing.
claims.source_url: https://github.com/tpn/pdfs (文件 'Managing the Development of Large Software Systems - 1970 (waterfall).pdf', sha256 9f7db065…a78)
claims.source_title: Royce, W.W., 1970, Managing the Development of Large Software Systems, Proc. IEEE WESCON (TRW 重印本 pp.328-338)

claims.claim: 'waterfall'一词不出现在 Royce 1970 原文中(对全 11 页 PDF 的文本层检索 0 次;独立 olmOCR 转录 8 个章节文件检索 0 次)。

claims.notes: 否定性核验:扫描件 OCR 有错字风险,但两种独立抽取一致为 0;多个二手核验(Milkeles/software-doc-templates、sa2taka 博客等)亦称不存在。

claims.claim: 已知最早把 Royce 的顺序图称为'waterfall'的印刷文献通常归于 Bell & Thayer 1976(TRW,ICSE'76 pp.61-68):在论证'自上而下方法优于自下而上'时,称 Royce'引入了开发活动的瀑布概念',并以纪律化顺序呈现(其 Fig.1 对应 Royce 自己说'招致失败'的 Fig.2)。
claims.quote: The same top-down approach to a series of requirements statements is explained, without the specialized military jargon, in an excellent paper by Royce [5]; he introduced the concept of the "waterfall" of development activities. In this approach software is developed in the disciplined sequence of activities shown in Figure 1.
claims.source_title: Bell, T.E. & Thayer, T.A., 1976, Software Requirements: Are They Really a Problem?, Proc. ICSE 2, pp.61-68
claims.notes: 未取得一手 PDF(ACM/镜像站被网络策略拦截)。引文来自两份独立转录(sa2taka/next-blog 日文博客的英文摘录;thorwhalen/essays 引文)逐字一致。'首次使用'是'目前已知最早'而非'创造';Bell & Thayer 与 Royce 同属 TRW。

claims.claim: Larman & Basili 2003(IEEE Computer)称 Royce 1970 常被'错误地'当作单趟瀑布的典范,并引 Royce 之子 Walker Royce 私人通信:其父'一直是迭代、增量、演进式开发的支持者';但同文也承认 Royce 的'做两遍'虽含反馈迭代的端倪,'显然不是经典的迭代增量开发(IID)'。
claims.quote: He was always a proponent of iterative, incremental, evolutionary development. His paper described the waterfall as the simplest description, but that it would not work for all but the most straightforward projects. ... This iterative feedback-based step in a classic "waterfall paper" has been lost in most descriptions of this model, although it was clearly not classic IID.
claims.source_title: Larman, C. & Basili, V.R., 2003, Iterative and Incremental Development: A Brief History, IEEE Computer 36(6):47-56
claims.notes: 读到的是 c2 wiki HistoryOfIterative 页面(Larman 上传的草稿摘录,BekaValentine/c2_wiki_recovery 存档)而非期刊终稿。Walker Royce 引语为私人通信、事后由亲属转述,属弱证据;Larman 是 IID/敏捷推广者(立场相关)。

claims.claim: Brooks《没有银弹》:构建软件最难的单一部分是'精确决定要构建什么';客户并不知道自己要什么,因此最重要的职能是'迭代地提取和细化产品需求';'可预先规定一个令人满意的系统、招标、建造、安装'这一采购假设'根本上是错误的'。
claims.quote: The hardest single part of building a software system is deciding precisely what to build. ... Therefore the most important function that the software builder does for his client is the iterative extraction and refinement of the product requirements. For the truth is, the client does not know what he wants. ... Much of present-day software acquisition procedures rests upon the assumption that one can specify a satisfactory system in advance, get bids for its construction, have it built, and install it. I think this assumption is fundamentally wrong
claims.source_title: Brooks, F.P., 1986/1987, No Silver Bullet: Essence and Accidents of Software Engineering, UNC TR86-020 / IEEE Computer 20(4)
claims.notes: 读到的是 tamnd/papers 对 UNC TR86-020(sha a4a11dcb…)的 olmOCR 视觉转录,未自看 PDF 页面;技术报告版与 1987 期刊版措辞可能略异。正方/反方皆可引:支持'需求是难点',但反对'一次性预先规定'。

claims.claim: Brooks 记录'自动编程'(由问题规约生成程序)已被期待近 40 年,并引 Parnas:'自动编程一直是用比当时可用的更高级语言编程的委婉说法';Parnas 认为多数情况下必须给出规约的是解法而非问题。
claims.quote: For almost 40 years, people have been anticipating and writing about "automatic programming", the generation of a program for solving a problem from a statement of the problem specifications. ... In short, automatic programming always has been a euphemism for programming with a higher-level language than was presently available to the programmer.
claims.source_title: Brooks, F.P., 1986, No Silver Bullet (引 Parnas)
claims.notes: 同 H11 转录口径。Parnas 原句是 Brooks 转引(Parnas 1985 SDI 相关论文),未回 Parnas 原文。与'spec 即新代码'口号直接对位的历史判断。

claims.claim: Brooks:即便完美的程序验证也只能证明程序符合其规约;软件任务最难的是得到完整一致的规约,构建程序的本质很大部分其实是'调试规约'。
claims.quote: More seriously, even perfect program verification can only establish that a program meets its specification. The hardest part of the software task is arriving at a complete and consistent specification, and much of the essence of building a program is in fact the debugging of the specification.
claims.source_title: Brooks, F.P., 1986, No Silver Bullet §4.7
claims.notes: 同 H11。可与 FORMAL 线'陈述=意图'鸿沟对接。

claims.claim: Brooks 对图形化/可视化编程的判断:'至今没有出现任何令人信服、更不用说令人兴奋的成果,我确信也不会有';流程图作为设计工具'基本无用'——'程序员是在写完程序之后、而非之前画流程图'。
claims.quote: Nothing even convincing, much less exciting, has yet emerged from such efforts. I am persuaded that nothing will. ... it has proved to be essentially useless as a design tool — programmers draw flowcharts after, not before, writing the programs they describe.
claims.source_title: Brooks, F.P., 1986, No Silver Bullet §4.6
claims.notes: 同 H11。'事后补画'对应后文 Petre 'retrofit' 与 SDD'事后补 spec'风险;是观点非测量。

claims.claim: Parnas & Clements 1986:'我们永远找不到一种让我们以完全理性方式设计软件的过程',但可以'伪装'——把系统按理性设计者的样子呈现(文档按理想过程组织);列 7 条理由,包括委托方不知道自己要什么、许多细节只在实现中才显现、外部变化会推翻先前决策。
claims.quote: The bad news is that, in our opinion, we will never find the philosopher's stone. We will never find a process that allows us to design software in a perfectly rational way. The good news is that we can fake it. ... (1) In most cases the people who commission the building of a software system do not know exactly what they want and are unable to tell us all that they know.
claims.source_title: Parnas, D.L. & Clements, P.C., 1986, A Rational Design Process: How and Why to Fake It, IEEE TSE SE-12(2)
claims.notes: 读到的是 AndrewGodlewsky/code-comments 仓库对 PDF 的逐页文本抽取(含 OCR 词内空格,已规整),未自看 PDF。对 SDD 的含义:spec 可作为'事后整理的理性化文档'而非真实生成顺序。

claims.claim: Parnas & Clements 1986 对文档维护的判断:按'意识流/执行流'组织的文档难以找到需随软件变更而修改的部分,'维护代价高昂,在大多数情况下不会被维护';未被使用过的文档'总会是糟糕的文档'。
claims.quote: It will not be easy to find all the parts of the document that should be changed when the software is changed. The documentation will be expensive to maintain and, in most cases, will not be maintained. ... documentation that has not been used before it is published, documentation that is not important to its author, will always be poor documentation.
claims.source_title: Parnas & Clements 1986, §VI
claims.notes: 同 H15。是'spec 漂移'的 40 年前机制描述,但属专家观点,无测量。

claims.claim: Dijkstra EWD667(约 1978):主张用母语指挥机器并不会简化人的工作,因为跨接口的协作/通信工作量需加上,'窄接口'因此受青睐;形式符号应视为'特权'而非负担;母语的'自然'归结为易于说出'其荒谬并不明显'的陈述。
claims.quote: Instead of regarding the obligation to use formal symbols as a burden, we should regard the convenience of using them as a privilege ... When all is said and told, the "naturalness" with which we use our native tongues boils down to the ease with which we can use them for making statements the nonsense of which is not obvious.
claims.source_title: Dijkstra, E.W., c.1978, On the foolishness of "natural language programming" (EWD667)
claims.notes: UT Austin EWD 档案被网络策略拦截;读到的是 limpdev/GoMark 的转录(加了高亮标记),与多份 GitHub 转录片段一致。纯论述。T1 自然语言 spec 的反方历史论据。

claims.claim: Boehm 1981《软件工程经济学》缺陷修复成本曲线(p.40)基于 1970 年代后期大型系统的四个来源(IBM、TRW、GTE、Bell Labs SAFEGUARD);Menzies 等指出 Daly77 与 Boehm76 未说明'成本'是工时还是实际费用,且'数据点未公开可供分析';同图另有虚线'较小项目'曲线明显平坦(需求→验收约 5-9 倍 vs 大项目→运行阶段约 100 倍以上)。
claims.quote: Figure~\ref{fig:cost-to-fix} shows the DIE as reported in Software Engineering Economics based on data from large systems in the late 70s from IBM, TRW, GTE, and Bell Labs. We note that it is unclear from the text in [Daly77] and [Boehm76] if cost is defined in terms of effort, or in actual cost (i.e., labor, materiel, travel, etc). The data points from these studies are not published for analysis.
claims.source_title: Menzies, T., Nichols, W., Shull, F., Layman, L., 2017, Are delayed issues harder to resolve? Revisiting cost-to-fix of defects throughout the lifecycle, Empirical Software Engineering 22:1903-1935(作者 LaTeX 源,2016-09 提交)
claims.notes: Boehm 1981 原书未取得;曲线是 Menzies 等重绘图(倍数为读图估计,对数轴)。读的是作者 LaTeX 源而非出版终稿(引文中 \cite 已删)。'100x'只对应大型项目、运行阶段、相对需求阶段,不能泛化。

claims.claim: Boehm & Basili 2001 'Top 10 缺陷减少清单'第 1 条:交付后发现并修复问题'往往'比在需求和设计阶段贵 100 倍;同条自限:对小型非关键系统,成本放大系数'更像 5:1 而非 100:1',良好架构实践可显著降低该系数。
claims.quote: Finding and fixing a software problem after delivery is often 100 times more expensive than finding and fixing it during the requirements and design phase. ... the cost-escalation factor for small, noncritical software systems is more like 5:1 than 100:1
claims.source_title: Boehm, B. & Basili, V.R., 2001, Software Defect Reduction Top 10 List, IEEE Computer 34(1):135-137
claims.notes: 未读到一手 PDF(umd.edu 被拦截)。两句均在 ≥4 份独立 GitHub 文档中逐字一致(含一份标注'Read in full (extracted locally)')。属杂志专栏、非同行评审研究;流行转述几乎总是丢掉'often'和'5:1'限定。

claims.claim: Bossavit 溯源:Pressman 版'1 : 6.5 : 15 : 60-100'比率引用的是 'IBM Systems Sciences Institute 1981 课程讲义';该机构实为 IBM 内部培训单位(洛杉矶,约 1967 年起运作,1982 年前更名),不是研究机构;称其为'IBM 研究'不当,原始项目数据(若存在)不晚于 1981 年、可能早至 1967 年。
claims.quote: the Institute was a corporate training program, not a research body; as such it is inappropriate to cite the source of the ratios as "an IBM study" or "a study by the IBM Systems Science Institute", in the total absence of any claim that the Institute was the primary source; the original project data, if any exist, are not more recent than 1981, and probably older; and could be as old as 1967.
claims.source_title: Bossavit, L., c.2019, The IBM Systems Science Institute (gist, 'Defect Cost Increase: Pressman Ratios')
claims.notes: 作者一手(Bossavit 的 GitHub 帐号 Morendil),非同行评审,依据 Google Books 广告、讣告、NYT。《Leprechauns of Software Engineering》(leanpub)本体未能访问,书中对 Boehm 曲线的完整论证未核。

claims.claim: Menzies 等 2017 对 171 个项目(2006-2014,全球,TSP 方法,47,376 条缺陷日志;212 个项目中剔除缺陷 <30 的 41 个)检验'延迟问题效应',未发现证据:后期阶段解决问题的工时并非一致或显著地高于引入后不久即解决。作者结论:DIE 可能是'历史遗物',只在某些类型项目中间歇出现。
claims.quote: We found no evidence for the delayed issue effect; i.e. the effort to resolve issues in a later phase was not consistently or substantially greater than when issues were resolved soon after their introduction. ... DIE might be an historical relic that occurs intermittently only in certain kinds of projects.
claims.source_title: Menzies et al., 2017, Are delayed issues harder to resolve?, EMSE 22
claims.notes: 利益相关:数据全部来自 TSP,而 TSP 由第二、三作者雇主(SEI)推广;项目偏小(中位工期 46 天、最长增量 90 天;中位团队 7 人,最多 40);修复工时为开发者自记。外推到大型/长周期/安全关键系统不成立——恰与 Boehm 大项目口径不重叠,两者并非直接矛盾。

claims.claim: Menzies 等的文献追溯:几乎所有关于延迟问题效应的引用都可追到 Boehm 1981 或其相关作品;Shull 等 2002 e-workshop 中 Toshiba 与 IBM 报告大项目早期 vs 交付后修复成本比 1:137 和 1:117,但未提供原始数据点;NASA JSC 数据显示某些非关键缺陷修复成本跨阶段基本恒定(早期均 1.2 小时 vs 后期 1.5 小时)。
claims.quote: nearly every citation to the delayed issue effect could be traced to the seminal Software Engineering Economics or its related works. ... Workshop participants from Toshiba and IBM reported cost-to-fix ratios between early lifecycle and post-delivery defects of 1:137 and 1:117 for large projects respectively -- but the raw data points were not provided and thus cannot be confirmed.
claims.source_title: Menzies et al., 2017, §2 文献综述
claims.notes: 二级综述中转述 Shull 2002,未回 Shull 原文。'1:117/1:137'同样是无原始数据的工作坊口径。

claims.claim: Petre 2013(ICSE)访谈 50 家公司的 50 名专业开发者,声明的当前 UML 使用:不用 UML 35、选择性使用 11、自动代码生成 3、事后补画(retrofit)1、全面采用 0(全面采用仅见于二手报告)。选择性使用者把 UML 当'思考工具',用完即弃。
claims.quote: Category of UML Use / Instances of Declared Current Use: no UML 35; retrofit 1; automated code generation 3; selective 11; wholehearted 0 ... Selective (11/50): UML is used in design in a personal, selective, and informal way, for as long as it is considered useful, after which it is discarded
claims.source_title: Petre, M., 2013, UML in Practice, ICSE 2013 pp.722-731
claims.notes: 读到的是 cefn/firmware-codesign-readinglog 中该论文 PDF 的 pdfx 全文抽取。方法部分称访谈'历时 2 年、超过 50 人',表格按 50 计;非随机抽样、定性研究;计数为个人而非团队。

claims.claim: Petre 2013 的不采用理由之一是同步/一致性:多名受访者指出图与图之间、模型与代码之间的同步/一致性问题是全面采用 UML 的障碍;并批评 UML 复杂、缺乏形式语义。
claims.quote: A number of informants identified issues of synchronization or consistency as a barrier for wholesale adoption of UML. ... Informants criticized UML for its complexity, lack of formal semantics, inconsistency, and issues of synchronization between different diagrams (and between models and code).
claims.source_title: Petre 2013, UML in Practice
claims.notes: 同 H23。'模型-代码同步'即 SDD 主张 2(spec 保持活性)的历史前科;'A number of'未给计数。

claims.claim: Hutchinson 等 2011(ICSE)MDE 产业研究:问卷 250+ 份 + 17 家公司 22 人深访 + 现场观察;文献综述显示 MDE 生产率宣称从 +20% 到 +800% 不等,比较研究结果在 +35% 到 −27% 之间,多数增益宣称无比较研究支持;生产率下降原因包括工具差、过度建模('模型瘫痪')、复杂度上升及'需保持模型/代码同步'。
claims.quote: These benefits have reportedly led to productivity increases ranging anywhere from 20 to 800% ... there is anecdotal evidence that cites reasons for decreased productivity – quantified at 27% in [18] – such as poor tool support, a tendency to over-model ("model paralysis"), increased complexity, and the need to keep models/code in sync. ... Of the comparative studies, results vary between a 35% gain to a 27% loss.
claims.source_title: Hutchinson, J., Whittle, J., Rouncefield, M., Kristoffersen, S., 2011, Empirical Assessment of MDE in Industry, ICSE 2011 pp.471-480
claims.notes: 读到的是 cefn 仓库 pdfx 全文抽取。作者自称定性为主、'应谨慎解读';问卷对象为 MDE 实践者(自选样本)。+20~800% 为文献中的宣称区间,不是本研究测量。

claims.claim: Whittle, Hutchinson, Rouncefield 2014(IEEE Software)调查 450 名 MDE 实践者 + 17 家公司 22 人访谈:MDE 可能比通常认为的更普遍,但开发者很少用它生成整个系统,而是用领域专用语言生成关键部分;多数公司体验到的生产率提升为 20-30%(报告范围 −27% 到 +800%),不足以驱动采用;代码生成是'转移注意力的话题',真正收益在于明确架构;有案例因生成代码可读性差导致代码认证成本升至 8 倍;采用主要取决于社会和组织因素。
claims.quote: Findings suggest that MDE may be more widespread than commonly believed, but developers rarely use it to generate whole systems ... although reports of productivity gains vary widely (from a 27% loss to an 800% gain [6]), most companies seem to experience productivity increases of between 20-30%. ... code generation is a red herring when it comes to describing MDE ... code certification costs rose by a factor of eight.
claims.source_title: Whittle, J., Hutchinson, J., Rouncefield, M., 2014, The State of Practice in Model-Driven Engineering, IEEE Software 31(3):79-85
claims.notes: 读到的是 cefn 仓库对作者稿 PDF 的 pdfx 抽取。样本是 MDE 实践者(幸存者偏差:不用 MDE 的人不在分母里);'20-30%'是'seem to'的定性归纳,非测量均值;'8 倍'是单一政府信息系统案例。

claims.claim: OMG MDA Guide 1.0.1(2003-06,omg/2003-06-01)的核心承诺:平台无关模型(PIM)包含足以驱动一个或多个平台特定模型(PSM)的信息,通过定义的变换由 PIM 映射到 PSM 并生成代码——即'模型为唯一事实源、代码可再生'的前代版本。
claims.quote: A Platform Independent Model (PIM) is an abstract model which contains enough information to drive one or more Platform Specific Models (PSM).
claims.source_title: OMG, 2003, MDA Guide Version 1.0.1 (omg/2003-06-01)
claims.notes: OMG 为标准联盟(成员含工具厂商),属利益相关方口径。未取得 OMG 原件(网络拦截),引文来自搜索摘要转述,需回一手。与 Tessl'spec-as-source'对照用。

claims.claim: Kemerer 1992(IEEE Software)研究 I-CASE 工具采用,论证学习曲线导致组织购入后弃用;流行二手转述称其报告'工具引入一年后 70% 从未使用、25% 仅一个小组使用、5% 广泛使用但未充分'——该组数字本线未能在一手文本中定位。
claims.source_title: Kemerer, C.F., 1992, How the Learning Curve Affects CASE Tool Adoption, IEEE Software 9(3):23-28
claims.notes: 作者 PDF(sites.pitt.edu)被网络拦截。70/25/5 数字疑为 Kemerer 转引的行业调查,出处链未核 → 按'未验证'处理,不得承重。CASE 衰落只能作方向性背景。

claims.claim: Binamungu 等 2018(SANER)调查 26 国 75 名 BDD 实践者:BDD 在受访者中活跃使用,但 20% 受访者所在组织强制使用、61% 作为可选工具;61% 认为规约中的重复会使其难以扩展和修改(可能导致功能'冻结');作者称从合作工程师处听到的轶事是维护挑战严重,'导致部分团队放弃该技术、回到面向技术的自动化测试'。BDD 规约面临与一般自动化测试套件相同的维护挑战。
claims.quote: Anecdotal evidence from the software engineers we have worked with suggest that the maintenance challenges, in particular, can be severe, and are leading some teams to drop the technique and to return to technology-facing automated testing to play the role of their BDD specifications. ... 61% of the respondents held the view that the presence of duplication in BDD specifications can cause them to become difficult to extend and change (leading potentially to frozen functionality).
claims.source_title: Binamungu, L.P., Embury, S.M., Konstantinou, N., 2018, Maintaining Behaviour Driven Development Specifications: Challenges and Opportunities, SANER 2018 pp.175-184
claims.notes: 作者自托管 PDF(经 GitHub 仓库 lepebina/lepebina.github.io 取得)。便利+滚雪球抽样、BDD 社区渠道招募(偏向在用者);'放弃'仅为轶事,无比例。T4 可执行规约的'活性维护'成本证据。

claims.claim: Cucumber 作者 Aslak Hellesøy(约 2014)称 Cucumber 是'世界上最被误解的协作工具':它首先是让团队跨角色建立共同理解的协作工具,而多数人把它当测试工具用,这种误用导致许多 Rails 团队弃用 Cucumber。
claims.source_title: Hellesøy, A., c.2014, The world's most misunderstood collaboration tool, Cucumber blog
claims.notes: cucumber.io 被拦截,仅见搜索摘要,无逐字引文。工具作者(后 Cucumber Ltd 创始人,2019 被 SmartBear 收购)自述,厂商口径。'弃用'是作者印象,无数据。

claims.claim: Zampetti 等 2020(IST)分析约 50,000 个流行开源项目(5 种语言)中 BDD 框架使用,并考察 BDD 规约是否与源码共同演化;结论方向:BDD 框架采用不少,但常被用于单元测试等非 BDD 本意用途,开发者认为 BDD 仍很费力。
claims.source_title: Zampetti, F., Di Sorbo, A., Visaggio, C.A., Canfora, G., Di Penta, M., 2020, Demystifying the adoption of behavior-driven development in open source projects, IST 123:106311
claims.notes: 全文未取得;仅搜索摘要。具体比例(多少项目用 BDD、共同演化程度)未核。二手资料对样本口径有矛盾(50,000 vs '20 个 Ruby 项目'),待验证。

claims.claim: Nagappan 等 2008:微软 3 个团队 + IBM 1 个团队的 TDD 案例研究,相对同组织中未用 TDD 的类似项目,发布前缺陷密度下降 40%-90%(TDD 团队为对照的 0.61/0.38/0.24/0.09 倍);初始开发时间增加 15-35%,但该时间数字为'管理层估计'(主观)。
claims.quote: The results of the case studies indicate that the pre-release defect density of the four products decreased between 40% and 90% relative to similar projects that did not use the TDD practice. Subjectively, the teams experienced a 15–35% increase in initial development time after adopting TDD.
claims.source_title: Nagappan, N., Maximilien, E.M., Bhat, T., Williams, L., 2008, Realizing quality improvement through test driven development: results and experiences of four industrial teams, EMSE 13:289-302
claims.notes: 一手 PDF 已读。非随机、4 对比较;作者自承比较对象可能是遗留系统增强 vs 新项目、TDD 团队可能更有动力;作者为微软研究院/IBM 员工(研究自家团队)。是被引最多但设计最弱的 TDD 证据之一。

claims.claim: TDD 元分析/综述方向:Rafique & Mišić 2013 对 27 项研究的元分析——TDD 对外部质量有小的正效应、对生产率几乎无可辨别效应,工业研究中质量提升与生产率下降均更大;Bissi 等 2016 系统综述(27 篇)——内部质量改进见于 76% 研究、外部质量 88%,生产率在学术情境上升、工业情境下降;Fucci 等 2017(39 名专业人员、82 个数据点)——质量与生产率主要与步长'粒度'和'均匀性'正相关,'测试与产品代码的书写顺序'无重要影响。
claims.quote: TDD has a small positive effect on quality but little to no discernible effect on productivity ... Sequencing, the order in which test and production code are written, had no important influence.
claims.source_title: Rafique & Mišić 2013 IEEE TSE 39(6); Bissi, Serra Seca Neto, Emer 2016 IST 74:45-54; Fucci, Erdogmus, Turhan, Oivo, Juristo 2017 IEEE TSE 43(7)
claims.notes: 三篇一手均未能取得(IEEE/arXiv/Elsevier 被拦截)。两句引文分别在 ≥3 份独立文档中逐字一致;Bissi 的 76%/88% 为'报告改进的研究占比'(计票法,非效应量)。design 字段取主体(Rafique 汇总的多为对照实验);实际混合:Rafique 为元分析、Bissi 为系统综述(计票)、Fucci 为观察性过程数据。对 SDD 的可迁移含义:'先写规约'的'顺序'本身可能不是有效成分。

claims.claim: Knuth 1984 提出文学编程:'让我们改变构造程序的传统态度:与其想象我们的主要任务是指示计算机做什么,不如集中精力向人类解释我们想让计算机做什么。'(以人可读的叙述为主、代码嵌入其中;WEB 系统)
claims.quote: Let us change our traditional attitude to the construction of programs: Instead of imagining that our main task is to instruct a computer what to do, let us concentrate rather on explaining to human beings what we want a computer to do.
claims.source_title: Knuth, D.E., 1984, Literate Programming, The Computer Journal 27(2):97-111
claims.notes: 一手 PDF 被拦截;引文在 ≥5 份独立 GitHub 文档中逐字一致。本线未找到文学编程采用率的系统调查数据(未搜到)——不能说'失败'或'成功',只能说未成为主流实践;其后代 Jupyter 的叙述/代码比例另有研究(Rule 等 2018 CHI,约 1/4 笔记本无解释性文本,仅二手摘要,未入表)。

网络约束:WebFetch 对 wikipedia/leanpub/arxiv/acm/ieee/umd 等全部 DNS 拦截;仅 GitHub(git clone + code search)与 WebSearch 摘要可用
cross_caliber_issues: 'Royce 反对瀑布' vs 'Royce 认为基本方法健全':两句都在原文,成文须同时引用;Royce 的修正是加重前置设计/文档 + 一次试点,不是轻量迭代
Royce 规约页数 1000 vs 1500:原件该位残损,不得单点引用
'waterfall 首次出现于 Bell & Thayer 1976' 是'已知最早'而非'创造';一手未读
Boehm 100x:仅大型项目、运行阶段相对需求阶段、1970 年代数据;同图小项目约 4-5 倍;Boehm & Basili 2001 自限 'often' 与 '5:1';成本单位(工时 vs 费用)不明
IBM SSI '1:6.5:15:60-100' 与 Boehm 曲线是两条不同出处链,不得合并
Menzies 2017 '无 DIE' 的样本为 TSP 小项目(中位 46 天)且修复工时自记、有 SEI 利益关联;与 Boehm 大项目口径不重叠,不能当作'推翻 Boehm'
Petre 35/50 是'个人声明的当前使用',非组织采用率;Whittle 450 人样本是 MDE 实践者(分母不含非使用者)
MDE 生产率:文献宣称 +20%~+800%、比较研究 +35%~−27%、Whittle 定性归纳 20-30%——三种口径不得混引
BDD '弃用' 仅为 Binamungu 轶事 + Hellesøy 印象,无比例数据;20%/61% 为受访组织强制/可选比例,非行业采用率
TDD:Nagappan 缺陷密度为 pre-release、对照为非随机同组织项目,开发时间为管理层主观估计;Bissi 76%/88% 为计票占比非效应量;Rafique '小正效应' 为元分析效应方向
Fucci 'test-first 顺序无重要影响' 若迁移到 SDD('spec 先行'),只能作类比假设,不是证据
历史类比的口径:Royce/Parnas/Brooks/Dijkstra 均为专家论述(评论),不是测量;不得与 PRO/CON/MEASURE 线的实验数据同级
